name: Quick Aid symptom triage cases
labelling_policy: Gold labels follow conservative, widely published first-aid and triage conventions (emergency warning signs; same-day vs routine care). expected_min is the LOWEST acceptable urgency (anything below is under-triage); expected_max is the HIGHEST reasonable urgency (anything above is over-triage); emergency=true means the emergency alert must fire; forbid_emergency=true means it must not.
limitations: Written by the developers, NOT clinician-validated, and small (about 100 cases). It is a regression and engineering check on the safety rules, not evidence of clinical accuracy. Do not use these numbers to claim the app is safe or accurate for real patients.
